prompt: The illustration is a panoramic cutaway of a vast AI factory in which a river of unbroken text and code is sliced by a laser grid into a torrent of tiny labeled blocks—whole words, prefixes, suffixes, blank spaces, and syntax fragments—that pour as input into a glowing central processor and stream out as output tokens; surrounding gauges and a towering digital counter marked “130 billion output tokens” track billing, speed, and memory while a minuscule finished page sits at the base, dwarfed by overflowing mountains of crumpled drafts, scratch calculations, and dense inter-machine message packets that link thousands of identical AI replicas, with a single human conversation visible only as a thin token trickle on the far edge, visually equating the same token accounting to both personal chat and massive self-talk and making plain that the volume far exceeds anything a team of human typists could ever produce.
